settings.heading: Estimates
settings.fallback: Delivery estimates are being confirmed with Australia Post and will appear here before launch.

settings.heading: Sending it to someone else
settings.body:
Put their address as the delivery address at checkout and your message in the gift message field. Your words are written on the card by hand and nothing else in the parcel mentions price.

Sending it to a workplace is fine. Put the company name in the address and we will keep it on the label rather than on the card.

settings.heading: If nobody is home
settings.body: We do not require a signature, because chasing a depot is not much of a gift. Australia Post will leave the parcel if it is safe to do so, or leave a card if it is not. You can add delivery instructions at checkout and we pass them on.

settings.heading: Tracking
settings.body: You will get a tracking link by email when the box is dispatched. If you are sending it as a gift, the tracking goes to you rather than to them.

settings.heading: Outside Australia
settings.body: We do not ship internationally yet. If you ask we will tell you honestly when that changes rather than take the order.

settings.heading: Getting it there
settings.intro: Free shipping Australia wide on every box, sent tracked with Australia Post. Most of our boxes go straight to the person receiving them, so there is no invoice inside and no pricing on the outside of the parcel.
